subject: biology
title: Monohybrid & Dihybrid Crosses Adventure
welcome_lead: Today you'll predict offspring with Punnett squares, from monohybrid to dihybrid.
meta_desc: A-Level Biology Genetics — alleles, dominant/recessive, codominance, monohybrid and dihybrid crosses with 9:3:3:1 ratio.
final_note: You learned how to draw monohybrid (3:1) and dihybrid (9:3:3:1) Punnett squares and how codominance (e.g. AB blood) and epistasis change classic ratios.

concepts.def: Length of DNA coding for a polypeptide
Different version of the same gene
Combination of alleles an organism carries
Both alleles fully expressed in heterozygote (e.g. AB blood)
One gene masks or modifies the expression of another

walkthroughs.body_html:
Cross two heterozygotes for one gene: Bb × Bb.

Punnett gives BB : Bb : Bb : bb → 3 dominant : 1 recessive phenotype.

If one parent is homozygous recessive (Bb × bb) → 1 : 1 ratio (a test cross — reveals unknown genotype).

In ABO blood groups there are three alleles: I^A, I^B, i.

- I^A and I^B are codominant — both fully expressed → AB blood
- i is recessive — only ii gives blood group O

Possible genotypes: I^AI^A or I^Ai → A; I^BI^B or I^Bi → B; I^AI^B → AB; ii → O.

Cross I^AI^B × ii → 1 A : 1 B.

Track two genes at once: e.g. seed shape (R/r) and colour (Y/y).

Cross RrYy × RrYy:

- 9 R_Y_ (round yellow)
- 3 R_yy (round green)
- 3 rrY_ (wrinkled yellow)
- 1 rryy (wrinkled green)

9:3:3:1 only works if genes are on different chromosomes (independent assortment).

Epistasis distorts this — e.g. 9:3:4 or 12:3:1 when one gene is masked.

mcqs.q: In ABO blood groups, what is the relationship between alleles I^A and I^B?
What phenotypic ratio is expected from a dihybrid cross between two double heterozygotes (assuming independent assortment)?

numericals.q: In a Punnett square Bb × Bb, what fraction of offspring (as a decimal) will be homozygous recessive (bb)?

free_texts.q: What name is given to a cross between an unknown organism and a homozygous recessive partner? Two words, lowercase.
free_texts.hint: Used to reveal the unknown genotype
